content: In summary, pretrained word embeddings do contain more information pertaining to semantic similarity than revealed in the initial vectors. This way, we have corroborated the hypotheses from prior work BIBREF113, BIBREF117 which were not previously empirically verified on other languages due to a shortage of evaluation data; this gap has now been filled with the introduction of the Multi-SimLex datasets. In all follow-up experiments, we always explicitly denote which post-processing configuration is used in evaluation.
